jurisdiction: United States research pilot; state/practice-area requirements still need an authorized firm-specific review.
source_frame: Action Model system-map industry slug law_firms; taxonomy reference only, not client demand or implementation proof.
scope_note: Law firms are the N1 research pilot. HALO is not classified as a law firm by this record. No client/matter data was accessed. Current software means verified marketed capability, not measured installed-base prevalence.
summary: Begin with supervised intake, approved-template assembly and evidence-preserving document review. Compare against the firm's existing software before replacing it. Neither exposure estimates nor a repository's features establish cash savings.

automation_research.finding: An occupational task inventory identifies legal-assistant document preparation, records organization and research. A preregistered 2024 study found errors in the legal AI research tools it tested despite retrieval grounding. This supports decomposing tasks and measuring supervised assistance; it does not supply a law-firm-wide automation rate or a current vendor-performance ranking.
automation_research.forecast_note: No independently verified percentage is used. The inaccessible Clio report was not treated as evidence, and task exposure is not realized automation.

processes.automation_boundary: Collect and normalize supplied fields; flag missing facts and possible matches; never accept a conflict or engagement automatically.
processes.baseline_required: Matched incumbent workflow volume, quality, human time including review/rework, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Human minutes per complete, accepted intake including review and chase
processes.falsifier: Reject if a known conflict/identity ambiguity is suppressed or completed intake takes no less total human time.
processes.human_authority: Firm-designated intake reviewer; lawyer owns conflict/engagement decision.

processes.automation_boundary: Populate approved templates from validated interview answers and return a draft plus field provenance.
processes.baseline_required: Matched incumbent workflow volume, quality, human time including review/rework, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Human minutes per correct, reviewed document; critical field errors
processes.falsifier: Reject if version/party/amount/date errors survive review or review effort erases assembly savings.
processes.human_authority: Qualified professional approves template/rules and final legal document.

processes.automation_boundary: Extract candidate facts with document/version/page references; reviewers accept/reject each finding.
processes.baseline_required: Matched incumbent workflow volume, quality, human time including review/rework, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Correct accepted findings per reviewer hour, with unsupported findings counted
processes.falsifier: Reject if a finding lacks its supporting source or cross-matter retrieval exposes restricted material.
processes.human_authority: Matter owner controls access and interpretation; extracted text is not legal advice.

processes.automation_boundary: Prepare a signing envelope only from approved immutable content; require explicit release authority.
processes.baseline_required: Matched incumbent workflow volume, quality, human time including review/rework, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Human coordination minutes per correctly completed signing workflow
processes.falsifier: Reject if signer/document identity changes undetected or benefit depends on bypassing approval.
processes.human_authority: Authorized firm sign-off; no automatic filing or signing.

processes.automation_boundary: Draft status updates from current records; route for review and send only when authorized.
processes.baseline_required: Matched incumbent workflow volume, quality, human time including review/rework, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurate approved update, including exception/retry review
processes.falsifier: Reject if stale status is sent as current, recipients cross matter boundaries or retries duplicate an action.
processes.human_authority: Firm communication owner retains recipient/content/send control.

processes.automation_boundary: Surface missing time descriptions, inconsistent identifiers or rejected line items in a read model; keep financial authority upstream.
processes.baseline_required: Matched incumbent workflow volume, quality, human time including review/rework, actual spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Review minutes per resolved exception; correction rate; actually recovered contribution margin
processes.falsifier: Reject if trust/billing state is overwritten or saved billable hours are counted both as cash and new revenue.
processes.human_authority: Billing/accounting owner; no trust-ledger or invoice replacement authorized.

observed_business_value.reason: No firm baseline, invoices, achieved automation rate, review/rework time, operating cost, displacement proof or eligible-population measurement. Null is not zero.

pilot.design: Within one authorized firm, compare matched routine work under the incumbent workflow and supervised candidate workflow. Start with synthetic/redacted fixtures; pre-register which documents/actions are in scope before using live data.
record: assisted human minutes including review and rework
reject_if: Human time including review/rework is not lower than the matched baseline.
Any privileged record crosses an unauthorized boundary or an unapproved external action occurs.
The result depends on treating draft/closed status as accepted legal work.
Measured first-year net cash is not positive for a cash-savings offer; capacity gains alone are not cash.

limitations: This is not legal advice, product admission or an industry-wide value forecast.
Current software adoption prevalence and current subscription prices were not verified; named offerings are not assumed to be installed.
No claim that a generic repository replaces the whole legal practice stack.
Rights, security, accessible UI, restoration and integration behavior remain product-owner gates.
